tools.name: timeline.create
tools.description: Start an empty timeline. Returns its timeline_id and its tracks (ids for track_id). Timelines are immutable: every edit returns a new timeline_id, and older ids stay valid for 24 hours after last use. For work longer than a day, keep the timeline.get document on your side and restore it with timelin

tools.name: timeline.get
tools.description: The full timeline: tracks, clips (frames, end exclusive), link groups and the media it uses. The server keeps a timeline 24 hours after last use: for work longer than a day, save this document on your side (it is the edit) and restore it with timeline.load.

tools.name: timeline.load
tools.description: Restore a timeline from the document timeline.get returned, e.g. after it expired (24 h after last use). Its media must still be here: media expires 7 days after last use, so import saved files again with media.import and swap them in with clip.replace.

tools.name: timeline.history
tools.description: The chain of edits that made this timeline, newest first. To go back, keep using an older timeline_id.

tools.name: timeline.diff
tools.description: Which clips, tracks and settings differ between two timelines.

tools.name: timeline.set_sequence
tools.description: Change resolution, frame rate or audio format. Clip times are kept in time, so they survive a rate change. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: track.add
tools.description: Add an empty video or audio track. New video tracks go on top. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: track.remove
tools.description: Remove a track and its clips. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: track.set
tools.description: Rename, mute (audio), hide (video) or lock a track. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: clip.add
tools.description: Place media on the timeline. A/V media lands as a linked pair on a video and an audio track. Default: the whole media, after the last clip, overwriting. A picture is scaled to fit the frame (a small logo fills it edge to edge); clip.set_transform {fit: "none"} keeps its own pixel size. Returns the e

tools.name: clip.remove
tools.description: Remove a clip and the clips linked to it; ripple closes the gap. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: clip.move
tools.description: Move a clip (and its linked clips) to a frame and optionally another track. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: clip.trim
tools.description: Move the start or end edge of a clip. side: video or audio trims one half of a link group (J/L cuts). Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: clip.split
tools.description: Cut a clip (and its linked clips) in two at a frame. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: clip.link
tools.description: Make clips move, trim and split together. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: clip.unlink
tools.description: Break the link group a clip belongs to. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: clip.set_enabled
tools.description: A disabled clip stays on the timeline but renders as a gap. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: clip.set_speed
tools.description: Speed up, slow down, ramp or reverse a clip and its linked clips. rate is constant; curve is a speed ramp over the clip. The clip keeps its source and its length changes; ripple (default) moves later clips. Pitch is kept unless preserve_pitch is false. Returns the edit result (see the server instruc

tools.name: clip.freeze
tools.description: Hold the frame at at_frame for duration_frames: the clip splits there, a freeze frame goes in, and later clips on its tracks move later. Freezing a clip's last frame holds it after the clip, with silence under the hold. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: clip.roll
tools.description: Move the cut between a clip and the clip right after it: one gets longer, the other shorter, nothing else moves. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: clip.slip
tools.description: Show earlier or later source in a clip without moving or resizing it. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: clip.slide
tools.description: Move a clip between its neighbours: the clip before it and the clip after it change length so nothing else moves. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: clip.replace
tools.description: Swap the media in a clip, keeping its place, length, speed and look. Starts at source_in (default 0). Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: range.lift
tools.description: Remove everything in a frame range on the given tracks (default all unlocked), leaving a gap. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: range.extract
tools.description: Remove everything in a frame range on the given tracks (default all unlocked) and close the gap. For cutting out silences, filler words or mistakes across all tracks at once. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: title.add
tools.description: Text on a video track, over the tracks below: styled with font, size, colour, outline, shadow and box, placed by x/y, revealed with a typewriter or word animation. A style field you leave out takes the published default (video://catalog/text: bold white Inter at 9% of the frame height, centred, with

tools.name: caption.add
tools.description: Captions on a video track from segments (with optional word timings for highlights), from SRT/VTT text, or in_clip: segments timed in seconds of a clip's media, such as transcript word times, placed where they play. One clip per caption; returns their clip_ids. A style field you leave out takes the

tools.name: text.set
tools.description: Change a title's or caption's text, or restyle many at once (clip_ids, or every one on track_id). The style is merged; null turns an outline, shadow, box or highlight off. Highlight modes and fonts: video://catalog/text and video://catalog/fonts. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions)

tools.name: audio.set_gain
tools.description: Volume of an audio clip (or a video clip's linked audio) in dB; keyframes ride it up and down. The preview is a waveform of the clip with the measured loudness. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: audio.set_pan
tools.description: Place a clip's sound left (-1) to right (1). Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: audio.fade
tools.description: Fade a clip's sound in from its start and out to its end. null removes a fade. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: audio.set_master
tools.description: Gain (dB) and limiter ceiling on the whole mix. The ceiling caps sample peaks (dBFS); the true peak between samples can land above it, most on dense, bright sound, and qa.check measures it (dBTP). Audio edits preview with the measured loudness. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: filter.add
tools.description: Apply an effect from video://catalog/effects (colour, LUT, blur, vignette, chroma key, glitch; EQ, compressor, denoise, pitch and more) to a clip, every clip on a track, or the whole timeline. Number params take keyframes. Returns its id as clip_id. Returns the edit result (see the server instructio

tools.name: filter.set
tools.description: Change an effect's params (merged) or turn it off and on. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: filter.remove
tools.description: Take an effect off. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: adjustment.add
tools.description: An empty clip on a video track whose effects (filter.add with its clip_id) change everything below it while it runs: a colour grade or blur over a stretch of the edit. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: transition.add
tools.description: Transition at the cut after a clip, into the clip that touches it (video://catalog/transitions). Linked audio gets a crossfade at the same cut. kind crossfade is sound only: on a video clip it crossfades the linked audio and the picture cuts hard (use mode handles for that). mode overlap (default) o

tools.name: transition.set
tools.description: Change a transition's kind or duration. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: transition.remove
tools.description: Remove a transition; the cut becomes a hard cut. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: clip.set_transform
tools.description: Position, scale, rotate, fade, flip, crop or fit a video clip over the tracks below (picture-in-picture, overlays, punch-ins). fit none shows a graphic at its own pixel size, so scale 1 is its real size; the default contain scales it to touch the frame edges. Any number takes a constant or {keyframe

tools.name: clip.set_blend
tools.description: How a video clip mixes with the tracks below: normal, multiply, screen, overlay and more (video://catalog/blend_modes). Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: clip.set_mask
tools.description: Show only part of a video clip: rectangle (rounded), ellipse, linear, mirror, heart, star or polygon, with feather and invert. Position, size, rotation and feather animate like transform values. null removes the mask. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: clip.set_animation
tools.description: Entrance, exit and loop presets layered over the clip transform (video://catalog/animations): e.g. in {name: "pop", duration_frames: 12}, loop {name: "float"}. null removes one. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

tools.name: edit.batch
tools.description: Apply many edits as one change: one new timeline_id, one preview. All apply or none do. Use {"$ref":"ops[N].clip_id"} (or track_id, clip_ids[M]) to use an id an earlier op made. Returns the edit result plus results: [{tool, clip_id?, clip_ids?, track_id?}] per op.

Gradients work like CSS: angle 180 runs top to bottom; radial reaches the corners; colours may carry alpha (#RRGGBBAA). Long-running like every create.* tool, but quick.

tools.name: create.voiceover

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: caption.add, media.import, media.upload, media.analyze, media.get, judge.ask, create.motion, create.still, create.voiceover, export.video, qa.check, export.timeline · Private data: timeline.create, timeline.get, timeline.load, audio.set_gain, audio.set_master, media.import, media.upload, media.list, media.delete, media.get, media.listen, create.motion, create.still, create.stems, create.lipsync, render.frames, export.video, job.get, export.timeline · Public sink: media.import, media.upload, media.list, create.lipsync, export.video · Destructive: timeline.set_sequence, track.remove, clip.remove, range.lift, range.extract, filter.remove, transition.remove, media.upload, media.delete, media.analyze, media.get, media.seek, media.listen, render.frames, export.timeline.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: caption.add, media.import, media.upload, media.analyze, media.get, judge.ask, create.motion, create.still, create.voiceover, export.video, qa.check, export.timeline · Private data: timeline.create, timeline.get, timeline.load, audio.set_gain, audio.set_master, media.import, media.upload, media.list, media.delete, media.get, media.listen, create.motion, create.still, create.stems, create.lipsync, render.frames, export.video, job.get, export.timeline · Public sink: media.import, media.upload, media.list, create.lipsync, export.video · Destructive: timeline.set_sequence, track.remove, clip.remove, range.lift, range.extract, filter.remove, transition.remove, media.upload, media.delete, media.analyze, media.get, media.seek, media.listen, render.frames, export.timeline

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
